tier1.headline: Your data is shared for ads
tier1.quote: When you view on-demand video on our websites, we may collect your viewing and usage information, and we may share information that identifies you as having viewed particular video content with service providers that enable video functionality, personalization, and usage analysis and third parties for advertising and marketing, as well as editorial purposes.

tier1.headline: Your data trains generative AI
tier1.quote: We may use generative AI to support us in providing the response or service requested; any output is subject to human oversight before being used.

tier1.headline: Your publication history is profiled
tier1.quote: Create a profile of your publication record based on publicly available data, such as published books and articles, citations and grants awarded.

tier1.headline: Your data is collected via aggregators
tier1.quote: Nature Research Intelligence processes personal data collected by research data aggregators such as Dimensions, Crossref, OpenAlex and others in order to generate aggregated research overviews of different research fields and topics.

tier2.headline: Your financial data is kept 10 years
tier2.quote: By statutory law we are required to retain the provided financial data in relation to transactions (including address, payment and order information) for ten years.

tier2.headline: Your data is transferred internationally
tier2.quote: Your personal data will be transferred to and processed inside and outside of the EEA.

tier2.headline: Your behavior is segmented by Permutive
tier2.quote: Permutive collects and processes pseudonymised data about user browsing behavior on our website in real time. This data is used to segment users into interest-based groups or “topics,” and to track engagement with eCommerce features such as product views and shopping activity.

tier2.headline: Your email targets online ads
tier2.quote: With your consent, we may occasionally run online advertising activities targeting you specifically by utilising personal information you have shared with us, namely your email address.

tier2.headline: Your data may go to authorities
tier2.quote: It is possible that the above providers may disclose your personal data to its business partners, third parties or authorities.
